== Summary ==
Players Committee card image of [[Endor: Anakin's Funeral Pyre]] (original printing), Virtual Set 17, as the PC published it on 21 December 2021, taken unchanged from the PC's card-image repository ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/8190af827ca5ef713205ed8648e28428656b00b1/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual17-Light/large/endoranakinsfuneralpyre.gif holotable commit 8190af8], file <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual17-Light/large/endoranakinsfuneralpyre.gif</code>; a PNG file served under a .gif name). Not a recreation.
